tiers.name: Pro
tiers.who_its_for: Founder or first sales hire running 10-100 active deals
tiers.rationale: Sits above Pipedrive Lite ($14) and below Attio Plus ($44); justified by zero-setup and Gmail-included positioning

tiers.name: Team
tiers.who_its_for: Post-seed team with 2-5 sales reps needing shared pipeline
tiers.rationale: Anchors below Pipedrive Growth ($39/seat) at team level; captures Series A expansion revenue
